unit: one recognizable empirical result or one author interpretation
identity_note: A finding id is not an output row number. The same sentence may support more than one finding.

question_type_rule.expression_or_distribution: The outcome is an expression, localization, or abundance measurement.
question_type_rule.prognostic_association: A marker, including expression, is the predictor and the outcome is survival or another prognostic endpoint. The word expression does not by itself make the finding an expression question.
question_type_rule.other: A result type the two classes do not cover. It is kept. It is not an author interpretation and it is not deleted.

direction_binding: A direction is stored only together with the measured object, the comparator, and the outcome. A tumor-versus-normal increase and a high-versus-low survival association do not share a bare increase label.
normalization: Only deterministic conservative normalization is allowed. A string difference is neither an automatic conflict nor an automatic synonym.
